title: Study 5 DynaSpace lateral 45 profile
citation: PPS Toolkit Study 5 DynaSpace lateral 45 protocol (2026). Box-breathing Study 5 variant adapted from the DynaSpace smartphone PPS validation stimuli. Unpublished lab profile.
notes: Unpublished Study 5 variant using original inhale/exhale instruction clips with the DynaSpace smartphone PPS white burst-train timing, 640-to-20 cm looming path, fixed-640 cm stationary-burst baseline comparator, six tactile anchors, and balanced left/right 45-degree source trajectories.

reference_parameters.paper_role: Study 5 respiratory-phase PPS variant using the DynaSpace smartphone looming/fixed-source timing and left/right 45-degree trajectory orientation.
reference_parameters.trajectory_balance_policy: Two source-level trajectory snapshots encode left -45 degrees and right +45 degrees. Segment 4 repetitions preserve equal left/right counts across audio-tactile, stationary-burst baseline, and catch families.
reference_parameters.baseline_policy: The smartphone fixed 640 cm comparator is mapped onto the Study 5 Segment 3 stationary_burst baseline family: each looming source is replaced by a fixed DynaSpace-style burst train at the same left/right 45-degree start anchor while tactile timing remains matched to the six DynaSpace anchors.
reference_parameters.source_asset_equivalence: trajectory, condition logic, 33-burst temporal structure, and approximate 95 ms burst spacing are matched; exact Android noise seed, Spat/LISTEN renderer, room response, phone transducer response, and motor mechanics are not bit-matched

stimulus_generation_operating_protocol.decision: Adopt the DynaSpace/Hobeika burst-train dry source as the smartphone-profile source profile while delegating spatialization to the 3DTI/SOFA renderer.
evidence_basis: Raw DynaSpace WAV audit detected 33 bursts with about 95 ms median inter-onset interval.
Hobeika lineage reports Gaussian white-noise bursts with 30 ms duration, 10 ms rise/fall, and 65 ms inter-burst interval.
Consensus searches supported broadband onset transients for localization/salience and supported HRTF/ILD/ITD/reverb/near-field cues as renderer-level spatial properties.
Consensus searches warned that rising intensity alone can produce looming salience, so matched-level controls remain necessary for causal inference.
stimulus_generation_operating_protocol.spatialization_policy: Render HRTF, ILD, ITD, near-field, distance attenuation, future trajectory angle, and optional room/DRR/IACC cues through 3DTI/SOFA rather than hard-coding them into the dry source.
stimulus_generation_operating_protocol.control_policy: Keep the DynaSpace replication contrast available, and add matched-level control variants for inference-focused future studies.

reference_parameters.stimulus_asset_policy: The public PPS Toolkit profile does not redistribute the Android app's raw WAVs. The preload catalog bakes 44.1 kHz toolkit-generated DynaSpace-style burst-train sources through the existing FABIAN/SOFA renderer so the profile remains runnable and publication-safe.
reference_parameters.noise_source_policy: Two DynaSpace-style white burst-train looming sources, left -45 degrees and right +45 degrees, with stationary-burst baselines generated from the same source snapshots. Segment 4 repetitions are audio-tactile 5.0, baseline 2.5, and catch 6.0 to retain the 204-row Study 5 budget despite six DynaSpace SOA anchors.

provenance.source: Derived from the repository canonical Study 5 profile: original 4-second inhale/exhale clips, Study 5 row order, pre/post run structure, catch family, and stationary-burst baseline workflow are preserved for the local lab context.
The smartphone validation profile encodes 3.85 s DynaSpace audio, 105 ms pre-hold, 2.945 s movement, 0.8 s post-hold, 640-to-20 cm approach, and tactile anchors at 105/1625/2385/2765/2955/3050 ms.
This local variant creates source-level left -45 degree and right +45 degree approach snapshots so Segment 4 can balance half of trials to each side.

The DynaSpace fixed 640 cm comparator is implemented as Study 5 stationary_burst baseline files generated from each left/right source snapshot, preserving fixed instruction audio and matched tactile anchors.
The original Android bursttrain WAVs are not redistributed; the profile uses PPS Toolkit generated DynaSpace-style Gaussian white-noise burst trains rendered through the bundled FABIAN/SOFA path.

Segment 4 repetitions use audio-tactile 5.0, baseline 2.5, and catch 6.0 to keep the Study 5 204-row total while adding the six DynaSpace tactile anchors and preserving balanced inhale/exhale and left/right counts.
